description: This file contains tests for the provider models in an Ollama API integration, including resolving API base URLs and enriching models with context windows.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Test hook cleanup to unstub all global mocks after each test.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for ollama provider models.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases under the test suite.

methods.name: vi.unstubAllGlobals
methods.description: Resets all mock/stub functions set globally by vi.

methods.name: vi.fn
methods.description: Creates a mock function for testing purposes.

methods.name: requestUrl
methods.description: Extracts URL string from request input.

methods.name: jsonResponse
methods.description: Generates a JSON response for mocking fetch.

methods.name: resolveOllamaApiBase
methods.description: Resolves the base URL of the Ollama API, stripping /v1 if present.

methods.name: enrichOllamaModelsWithContext
methods.description: Enriches models with context window info by fetching from /api/show.

ctags.name: body
ctags.pattern: /^      const body = JSON.parse(requestBodyText(init?.body)) as { name?: string };$/

ctags.name: fetchMock
ctags.pattern: /^    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: string | URL | Request, init?: RequestInit) => {$/
